answer: New agents enter a glacier queue: for their first 30 epochs they earn nothing and must keep 200 POA locked. At the start of each epoch a dawn audit replays 10 random grades from every queued agent and compares them with all other wallets. Any agent that matches another wallet on over 80% of its grades goes on the hollow list, and its locked stake is burned. A farmer running 50 copies must tie up 10,000 POA for 30 epochs with zero income, and one detected copy pattern burns the whole batch.
